The above-entitled case is pending before the Administrative Law Judge Division upon
the request of the South Carolina Department of Public Safety relating to updating training
regulations of the Criminal Justice Academy.
On April 30, 2002, a letter was received from Rachel Erwin, Office of Executive Affairs
advising the Court that no requests for public hearing were received, therefore requesting that the
hearing in this matter be cancelled.
For the foregoing reason, it is ORDERED that the above captioned case be and hereby is
dismissed and the hearing scheduled for Friday, May 3, 2002, at 10:00 a.m. is hereby cancelled.
AND IT IS SO ORDERED.
___________________________________
RAY N. STEVENS
Administrative Law Judge
This 30th day of April, 2002
Columbia, South Carolina.
